findings.issue: Wrong reading of ビル風: the compound ('building wind', the wind phenomenon around tall buildings) is read ビルかぜ (JMdict/Daijisen: ビルかぜ), not ビルふう. ふう is the 'style' suffix reading and does not fit this word.
findings.current: かぜがつよいのわびるふうのせいです。
findings.suggested: かぜがつよいのわびるかぜのせいです。

findings.issue: 風 in ビル風 reads かぜ, not ふう (word is ビルかぜ). The token's note ('風 lido ふう como sufixo' / '風 read ふう as a suffix') asserts the same wrong reading and must be corrected too; wind compounds keep かぜ (春風, 追い風), ふう is the 'style' suffix (和風).
Missing rendaku: 思い通り is read おもいどおり (JMdict/Daijisen), like 予定どおり/元どおり. おもいとおり is a wrong reading.
findings.current: どうしてもじぶんのおもいとおりにしたがるね。
findings.suggested: どうしてもじぶんのおもいどおりにしたがるね。

findings.issue: In the compound 思い通り the suffix 通り undergoes rendaku and is read どおり in context (おもいどおり), not とおり.
Propagates the wrong ビル風 reading: birufuu should be birukaze (ビルかぜ).
Propagates the missing rendaku: omoitoori should be omoidoori (思い通り = おもいどおり).

This し belongs to the fossilized adverb どうしても (どう+して+も), split across tokens[0..3]. Calling it 'verbo principal (radical de する em 〜にしたがる)' is false — the base of したがる is the second し (tokens[9]). Learner would think the main verb appears at position 1.
findings.current: verbo principal (radical de する em 〜にしたがる)
findings.suggested: parte da expressão fixa どうしても (どう + して + も)

findings.issue: 'Either way' mistranslates どうしても, which here means 'no matter what / at any cost' (as the expl_en itself states). Also 'he/she' clashes with en/pt/expl, which all identify the subject as 'you'.
findings.current: Either way, he/she wants to do it their own way, huh.
findings.suggested: No matter what, (you) show wanting to do it your own way, huh.

findings.issue: tokens[0] (思い) and tokens[1] (出し) are spurious stray tokens prepended before 君 with all-null glosses; concatenating token surfaces no longer reconstructs jp (思い出し君にあうと…). 思い出し is already correctly tokenized at tokens[11]. Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1].
findings.current: 思い (tokens[0]) and 出し (tokens[1]), stray leading tokens
findings.suggested: (delete tokens[0] and tokens[1]; 思い出し is already correctly tokenized later)

findings.issue: The parenthetical literal gloss is inverted: 入れる literally means 'to put IN', never 'to put out' (that is 出す). It also contradicts expl_en, which correctly says lit. 'to put in', and the pt gloss '(lit. colocar)'.
findings.current: to prepare / serve (lit. to put out)
findings.suggested: to prepare / serve (lit. to put in)

findings.issue: Garbled telegraphic opening: 'Heart is conditional と' and '君にあうと … is an automatic, habitual consequence' — the と-clause is the CONDITION, it expresses/triggers the automatic consequence (expl_pt says 'expressa' correctly). As written the en mislabels condition as consequence.
findings.current: Heart is conditional と: 君にあうと ('whenever I meet you') is an automatic, habitual consequence.
findings.suggested: The heart is the conditional と: 君にあうと ('whenever I meet you') expresses an automatic, habitual result.

findings.issue: Dangling cross-reference: 'Mesma construção da frase anterior' — corpus sentences are standalone records referenced by ID, so 'the previous sentence' does not exist for the learner. Rewrite standalone.
findings.current: Mesma construção da frase anterior: 君が怒る ("você ficar bravo") é nominalizado por の...
findings.suggested: 君が怒る ("você ficar bravo") é nominalizado por の, e o predicado é もっともだ ("é natural").

findings.issue: Same dangling comparison as expl_pt: opens 'Same construction:' and later 'Difference is も instead of は', comparing to a sibling sentence that is not present in a standalone record. Rewrite without the comparison.
findings.current: Same construction: 君が怒る ('you getting angry') nominalized by の, predicate もっともだ ('it's natural'). Difference is も instead of は...
findings.suggested: 君が怒る ('you getting angry') is nominalized by の; も ('also') marks it, and the predicate is もっともだ ('it's only natural').

findings.issue: Stale QA meta-commentary leaked into the learner-facing note: 'não "minuto" como sugere o gloss_en' (en variant likewise) — the current gloss_en says 'portion / share', so the note references a defect that no longer exists and only confuses. Same in both locales.

findings.issue: Stale QA meta-commentary in learner-facing note: claims "gloss_en 'to get dark' está errado" (confusion with 暮れる), but the current gloss_en is already correct ('to do the favor of'). Remove the meta remark in both locales.
